description: This file defines the Admin controller for the Coocook web application, implementing various administrative actions such as viewing organizations, projects, recipes, and users, and setting up submenu items for the admin interface.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative routes and actions for the Coocook application.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Sets up the base path for admin routes and initializes submenu items.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main admin dashboard with recent organizations, projects, recipes, and users.

methods.name: organizations
methods.description: Lists all organizations with links to their detail pages.

methods.name: projects
methods.description: Lists all projects with owner information and links.
